input.sql:
SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' k, count(*)::text v FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_without_lines', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_without_hdr', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_not_AP', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."SRC_CD"<>'AP'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_amt_ne_inv', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_multi_pay', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_no_pay', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'postdt_outside_period', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_vend_invno', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_inactive_acct', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE c."ACTV_FLG"='N'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_line_keys', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO","LN_SEQ" HAVING count(*)>1) x

SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_NM", count(*) n, sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT "SRC_CD", "SRC_REF", count(*) n, min("MEMO") m1, max("MEMO") m2 FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
